It's Christmas morning. Although Santa had just spent a long, long night delivering presents all around the world, his Christmas Spirit keeps him energetic and cheerful. He enters his living room, where he sees a large, wrapped present sitting beneath the Christmas Tree.

"Well, what do we have here?" Remarks Santa with feigned surprise. "A gift? For me? I wonder what it could be!"

But Santa knows full well what his present is this year. In fact, he picked it himself.

Mrs. Claus gets up from the nearby recliner, giving her husband a welcoming hug. "I already opened my present, darling~." Coos Mrs. Claus. "I'm going to go and play with it some more. You can have some alone time with your special toy~." The two exchange knowing smirks as Mrs. Claus saunters away.

Santa leans down to read the label on his present: *To: Santa. From: Mrs. Claus.* He expertly tears off the wrapping paper, revealing a plain box with a lid. As he takes off the lid, his eyes light up with joy. "Ho ho ho! Merry Christmas to me!" Inside the box is a human — nude, blindfolded, gagged, and tied up in red ribbons. A colorful variety of dildos and vibrators line the insides of the box—Santa's favorite type of toy.

Santa gently removes the blindfold and gag, getting a better look at his new present. Santa leans in, his voice taking on a playful tone: "So, have you been *nice* this year? Or perhaps...you made the *Naughty List*?"
